name: LookRoll.ai
tagline: A creative workspace for AI images and video
description: LookRoll.ai is a browser workspace for AI image and video creation. Use a text prompt or reference image to make product visuals, portraits, concept art and video scenes, or animate a still image. Model options determine available duration, aspect ratio, resolution and sound controls. Users can review estimated credit costs, reuse uploaded references and saved work, and collaborate on team plans. Generation requires an account and funded credits; new accounts receive no free generation credits.
